changelog:
v4.0.0 — Engine Optimization:
- Replaced all dumpsys calls with direct sysfs reads (battery, screen, charging).
- Intent engine poll intervals doubled (5s→10s interactive, 60s→120s sleep).
- Process monitor interval increased to 120s, PID scan capped at 200 apps.
- Thermal daemon uses sysfs-only detection, 30s interval.
- Dashboard refresh pauses when app is backgrounded.
- Chart replot skipped when data unchanged.
- Staggered daemon starts to avoid boot burst.
